complexity.notes: The half-open-interval formulation with the descent test against the left endpoint is less common than comparing mid to the right endpoint, but it is correct and the (start+1) % len(nums) wrap cleanly handles the zero-rotation case. No correctness or complexity concerns.
complexity.summary: Binary search over a half-open [start, end) interval: comparing nums[start] to nums[mid] reveals which half contains the single descent, and the interval is halved until it pins the rotation point, with a modulo wrap to cover the unrotated case.
